shadows.name: composer
shadows.purpose: Soft depth under the translucent home composer.

components.name: Reading link
components.description: Underlined links used across reading surfaces.
components.css: .ds-reading-link{font-family:'Space Grotesk','SF Pro Display','Segoe UI',-apple-system,sans-serif;transition:color var(--ui-speed-fast) var(--ui-ease),background-color var(--ui-speed-fast) var(--ui-ease),border-color var(--ui-speed-fast) var(--ui-ease);color:#a7f3d0;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:.25em}.ds-reading-link:hover{color:#d1fae5}.ds-reading-link:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Main navigation
components.description: Persistent reading destinations; current page is underlined.
components.html: PublicationsBlog
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:.25rem}.ds-nav a{font-family:'Space Grotesk','SF Pro Display','Segoe UI',-apple-system,sans-serif;transition:color var(--ui-speed-fast) var(--ui-ease),background-color var(--ui-speed-fast) var(--ui-ease),border-color var(--ui-speed-fast) var(--ui-ease);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;padding-inline:.4rem;font-size:.8125rem;color:#d4d4d8;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a:hover,.ds-nav a[aria-current="page"]{color:#a7f3d0}.ds-nav a[aria-current="page"]{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:.4em}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring);outline-offset:2px;}@media(min-width:640px){.ds-nav{gap:.75rem}}

components.name: Send action
components.html: <button class="ds-send" type="button"><svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.9" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m3 3 3 9-3 9 19-9Z"/><path d="M6 12h16"/></svg>Send</button>
components.css: .ds-send{font-family:'Space Grotesk','SF Pro Display','Segoe UI',-apple-system,sans-serif;transition:color var(--ui-speed-fast) var(--ui-ease),background-color var(--ui-speed-fast) var(--ui-ease),border-color var(--ui-speed-fast) var(--ui-ease);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.375rem;height:2.25rem;border-radius:9999px;border:1px solid oklch(82.8% .111 230.318 / 30%);background:oklch(74.6% .16 232.661 / 10%);padding-inline:.75rem;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;color:oklch(97.7% .013 236.62)}.ds-send:hover{border-color:oklch(90.1% .058 230.902 / 45%);background:oklch(74.6% .16 232.661 / 18%)}.ds-send:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring);outline-offset:2px;}.ds-send:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;border-color:rgb(255 255 255 / 14%);background:oklch(21% .006 285.885);color:oklch(55.2% .016 285.938)}

components.name: Composer input
components.description: Multiline input inside the translucent home composer.
components.css: .ds-composer{border-radius:1.7rem;border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 9%);background:oklch(14.1% .005 285.823 / 78%);padding:.875rem;box-shadow:0 14px 32px rgb(0 0 0 / 28%);backdrop-filter:blur(24px)}.ds-input{font-family:'Space Grotesk','SF Pro Display','Segoe UI',-apple-system,sans-serif;max-height:11rem;min-height:4rem;width:100%;resize:none;border-radius:1rem;border:0;background:transparent;padding:.5rem;font-size:15px;line-height:1.75rem;color:oklch(96.7% .001 286.375)}.ds-input::placeholder{color:oklch(55.2% .016 285.938)}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring);outline-offset:2px;}@media(min-width:640px){.ds-composer{padding:1rem}}

components.name: Prompt suggestion
components.description: Compact pill actions that wrap below the home introduction.
components.css: .ds-prompt{font-family:'Space Grotesk','SF Pro Display','Segoe UI',-apple-system,sans-serif;transition:color var(--ui-speed-fast) var(--ui-ease),background-color var(--ui-speed-fast) var(--ui-ease),border-color var(--ui-speed-fast) var(--ui-ease);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;height:2.25rem;border-radius:9999px;border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 10%);background:oklch(21% .006 285.885 / 72%);padding-inline:.75rem;font-size:.75rem;color:oklch(87.1% .006 286.286)}.ds-prompt:hover{border-color:rgb(255 255 255 / 18%);background:oklch(27.4% .006 286.033 / 80%);color:oklch(96.7% .001 286.375)}.ds-prompt:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring);outline-offset:2px;}.ds-prompt:disabled{cursor:not-allowed;opacity:.5}

components.name: Context status card
components.description: A subdued status surface within home conversations.
components.css: .ds-status{max-width:34rem;border-radius:1.35rem;border:1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 8%);background:oklch(21% .006 285.885 / 54%)}.ds-status button{font-family:'Space Grotesk','SF Pro Display','Segoe UI',-apple-system,sans-serif;transition:color var(--ui-speed-fast) var(--ui-ease),background-color var(--ui-speed-fast) var(--ui-ease),border-color var(--ui-speed-fast) var(--ui-ease);display:block;width:100%;border:0;border-radius:1.35rem;background:transparent;padding:.625rem .75rem;text-align:left}.ds-status button:hover{background:rgb(255 255 255 / 3%)}.ds-status button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring);outline-offset:2px;}.ds-status-label{display:block;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:oklch(70.5% .015 286.067)}.ds-status-text{display:block;margin-top:.25rem;font-size:13px;line-height:1.625;color:oklch(92% .004 286.32)}
